long_biography.plain_text:
Medicine preceded business in Grekin's professional formation. He grew up within a century-long family tradition of physicians, including seven dermatologists. He then studied gerontology at the University of Michigan and earned his osteopathic medical degree at Des Moines University. After dermatology residency, he established Grekin Skin Institute, combining clinical care with a research division and services for older patients through Bedside Medical Group.

The practice's sale to Advanced Dermatology and Cosmetic Surgery in 2014 shifted Grekin from founder-led regional practice into a wider leadership role. He now serves as chief growth officer and medical executive committee chair emeritus while continuing to treat patients. His work also includes clinical education, pharmaceutical trials, skin-rejuvenation research and recent collaboration on cellular repigmentation for stable vitiligo.
